blocks.text: Lake Titicaca, Isla del Sol and La Paz

Breakfast.

Early in the morning, transfer from your hotel to the Bolivian border. After clearing border control, continue into Bolivia to Copacabana, a lakeside town on Lake Titicaca known for its religious shrines and scenery.

Then take a catamaran across Lake Titicaca, one of the world's highest navigable lakes.

The day's highlight is a visit to Isla del Sol, or the Island of the Sun, which Inca legends link to the origins of their civilisation. The island is known for its ancient archaeological sites, traditional settlements and sweeping views of the lake's turquoise waters and surrounding mountains.

On the island, learn about local traditions and take part in a symbolic Kallawaya ritual honouring Pachamama, or Mother Earth, whom Andean communities thank for life and the gifts of nature.

Lunch at a restaurant with panoramic views of Lake Titicaca.

Continue across the lake to the Bolivian shore, then drive to La Paz. The city lies at around 3,600–4,000 metres above sea level, depending on the neighbourhood.

La Paz is Bolivia's largest urban centre and the seat of its government. Set among mountains, it brings together colonial architecture, modern neighbourhoods and traditional Andean markets.

Stay at the 4-star Mitru hotel or a hotel of the same category.
